<description>
Only P2SH-P2WPKH inputs are eligible, which require a non-empty witness. Consensus forbids a witness on non-segwit P2SH inputs, so check the witness (and the cheap pubkey size check) before evaluating the scriptSig. This avoids evaluating scriptSigs of up to `MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE` for the common case of non-segwit P2SH spends.
</description>
